name: io.github.kazsakaiwork-code/jp-public-signals
description: Read-only Japanese public open data: procurement award statistics and 法人番号 register changes. Unofficial archive of public open data: not an official source and not affiliated with any government body.

environmentVariables.name: DELTAKURA_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Path to a local Deltakura data directory. When set, the 法人番号 tools read it directly instead of calling the hosted API.

environmentVariables.name: DELTAKURA_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the hosted Deltakura read API. Defaults to https://deltakura-api.deltakura.workers.dev/v0.

environmentVariables.name: DELTAKURA_API_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to call the hosted API. While it is 0 or unset the 法人番号 tools make no network request and report that remote mode is off.

environmentVariables.name: DELTAKURA_NTA_MAX_SCAN_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Cap on the gzipped bytes of local change files scanned per call. Defaults to 268435456.
